patterns.note: Full-width dark background with a central content column, creating a focused and immersive experience.
Prominent, extra-large sans-serif headings paired with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text, establishing a clear typographic hierarchy.
A high-contrast dark mode palette featuring deep black backgrounds, bright white text, and minimal, strategic color accents for emphasis.
The main hero image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls, adding depth to the initial view.
Sections are introduced by large, centered, bold headings, often followed by a descriptive paragraph, creating distinct content blocks on the dark canvas.

technique_notes: Implement a dark mode design system where the primary background is a deep black, and primary text is bright white, ensuring high contrast and readability.
Utilize a sticky header that remains at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling, providing constant access to navigation.
Create a subtle parallax scrolling effect for the hero image, where the image moves at a slower rate than the foreground text, giving a sense of depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold headings (~3-4x body) with clean, readable body text
design_tokens.radius: subtle (small corner radius on buttons and UI elements)
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with airy sections around major headings and tighter spacing in feature lists

standout: The site's striking use of a deep black canvas, combined with crisp white typography and integrated, interactive-looking UI screenshots, creates a highly sophisticated and developer-centric aesthetic. The subtle parallax on the hero image adds a premium layer of depth without visual clutter.
